Naganadel

Poison Dragon

Alola · Generation 7

Naganadel is a Poison/Dragon-type Poison Pin Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 3.6 m tall and weighs 150 kg. It evolves from Poipole. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (127), with a base stat total of 540.
